summary: ATI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of $450 million aggregate principal amount of unsecured 5.875% Senior Notes due 2033. The notes were issued under a shelf registration statement and a supplemental indenture, with semi-annual interest payments starting December 15, 2026, and maturity on June 15, 2033. The filing details optional redemption provisions, including a make-whole premium before June 2029 and a 35% equity-clause redemption. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation like a tender offer or restructuring. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
